name: sfml
description: Tooling for the SFML specification, its JSON Schema, and its conformance suite.

scripts.render:mermaid: node tools/sfml-to-mermaid.mjs .craftmill/factory.sfml > .craftmill/factory.mmd && node tools/sfml-to-mermaid.mjs conformance/parser/full/factory.sfml > conformance/parser/full/factory.mmd
scripts.test: npm run validate:schema && npm run validate:conformance && npm run test:example && npm run lint:craftmill && npm run test:tools
